This can be a great way to build stronger bonds with the people in your life, but it also means you may need to be more intentional about nurturing those relationships. 5. **More opportunities for self-directed learning and growth**: Without a traditional calendar, you may have more freedom to pursue your interests and passions at your own pace. This can be a great opportunity for self-directed learning and personal growth, but it also requires discipline and motivation to stay on track. Ultimately, not having a traditional calendar can be both a blessing and a curse.
